claims.claim_text: The United Nations can play an integral role in U.S. Forward Engagement policy.
The United Nations needs both resources and reform to play an integral role in U.S. Forward Engagement policy.
Commitment to U.S. leadership in providing resources for, and reforming, the United Nations so it can play an integral role in Forward Engagement.
Support for globalization that benefits everyone rather than overwhelming vulnerable people.
Support for increasing U.S. investment in the International Labor Organization.
Support for expanding U.S. trade preferences linked to improvements in core labor standards.
Support for reversing widening economic gaps between rich and poor people and between nations.
Al Gore and the Democratic Party support debt forgiveness for the world's poorest nations to reverse widening economic inequality.
